subject: Observability evidence export & SIEM handoff — VPC delivery protocol
messages:
From: John Rogers <john.rogers@acmecorp.com>
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
Cc: secops@acmecorp.com, alice.tran@acmecorp.com
Date: Wed, 17 Apr 2029 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: VPC SIEM handoff + evidence export window

Rafael — thanks for taking this. We're preparing for an internal compliance review and need a short-run export of logs/metrics/traces from the Redwood private deployment in our VPC. Key asks: a) exact retention windows for API request logs, embeddings/response payload retention policy, b) a packaged evidence bundle we can drop into our SIEM (Splunk) — sample time range 2029-03-01 to 2029-03-31, c) guidance for the forwarder config (HEC endpoint + TLS settings) and any expected hostnames/ports.

Can you confirm what you can provide out of the box and an ETA? We're on a tight schedule for the compliance committee next Thursday.

Thanks,
John Rogers
Sr. SecOps Engineer, AcmeCorp
[Attachment: compliance_scope.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
To: John Rogers <john.rogers@acmecorp.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 17 Apr 2029 09:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: VPC SIEM handoff + evidence export window

John — thanks for the clear scope. We can produce a packaged evidence export and a recommended forwarder config. Quick answers up front:
- Retention: API request logs and routing metadata kept for 90 days by default in Private (configurable by enterprise contract); metrics and traces retained for 30 days in the default telemetry pipeline unless long-tail retention is enabled.
- Export: We can generate a one-off evidence bundle for 2029-03-01 → 2029-03-31 (logs, metrics aggregates, trace samples with links to full traces where allowed).
- Forwarder: we'll provide a HEC-compatible payload + TLS mutual-auth guidance for Splunk HEC.

I'll coordinate a technical handoff with Kim and Marissa. Expect an initial evidence_manifest and sample logs within 6 business hours, full bundle by EOD. If you need a formal attestation or signed checklist, flag it and I'll route to our compliance lead.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Head of Solutions Engineering, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-quick-qa.txt (text/plain)]

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: John Rogers <john.rogers@acmecorp.com>, rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 17 Apr 2029 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: VPC SIEM handoff + evidence export window

John / team — attaching the artifacts you'll need to ingest into Splunk and the recommended forwarder template. Notes:

1) Evidence bundle contents (attached)  - evidence_manifest.csv — file-level index (timestamp ranges, checksums, redaction flags)  - sample_logs.gz — gzipped NDJSON of request/response logs for the window  - traces_export.ndjson — sampled trace spans (contains trace_id references)  - metrics_metrics.json — aggregated metrics snapshots (1m rollups)

2) Forwarder guidance  - Use HEC token with mTLS enforced at the customer gateway. We recommend HEC batch size 500 events, max latency 5s.  - Hostnames: {redwood-forwarder.acmecorp.internal}:8088 (TLS). If your environment uses an egress proxy, route to that proxy.  - Field mapping: see 'forwarder-config.yaml' attached for attribute -> Splunk field mapping (request_id, model_name, inference_time_ms, tokens_in, tokens_out, user_id_hash).

3) Tracing hooks and sample retention  - We include trace_id references in the traces_export.ndjson. Full KV cache / raw decoder traces are not exported by default; if you require full raw spans we need a short-term expanded retention job (adds ~2-3GB for the month).

4) Redaction and PII  - The bundle has PII redaction applied at collection time per our standard private-deploy policy. If you need raw payloads for an internal incident, we require a signed data access addendum.

Attachments: forwarder-config.yaml (text/yaml), evidence_manifest.csv (text/csv), sample_logs.gz (application/gzip), redwood-evidence-checklist.pdf (application/pdf)

--
Kimberly Park
Senior Product Manager, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: John Rogers <john.rogers@acmecorp.com>, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 17 Apr 2029 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: VPC SIEM handoff + evidence export window

John — one operational clarification: will Acme want the evidence bundle as a single delivered archive or streamed to your Splunk HEC ingest? Two options we can support:

Option A — Delivered bundle (recommended for audit): we prepare a signed archive (tar.gz) containing the manifest + exports; you retrieve it from a short-lived S3 pre-signed URL in your VPC (no public exposure). This is easiest for compliance walkthroughs.

Option B — Direct push: Redwood's forwarder can POST batched events to your HEC endpoint for the window (needs ephemeral credentials and a temporary network path). This is better if you want immediate ingestion into dashboards but requires network coordination.

Also flagging retention windows again: if you want full raw trace payloads for the month of March we'll need approval from our data governance team (I can open that; expect 24–48 hours).

If Option A works, we'll send the pre-signed retrieval link and the signed checklist by 16:00 PT today.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Technical Program Manager, Customer Reliability Team
Redwood Inference

From: John Rogers <john.rogers@acmecorp.com>
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 17 Apr 2029 12:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: VPC SIEM handoff + evidence export window

Thanks everyone — Option A is preferable for the audit. Please proceed with the signed archive approach. Two quick asks before you upload: 1) include a short README that lists any redactions performed, 2) include checksums in the manifest and a contact for any decryption keys or access steps.

I'll route the DocuSign for the data access addendum if we end up needing full raw traces. For now, the checked bundle should be sufficient. ETA request: can we get the presigned URL + checklist by 16:00 PT?

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—John
Sr. SecOps Engineer, AcmeCorp
